question: In which location is the 17th edition of the India-Mongolia joint military Exercise NOMADIC ELEPHANT being conducted, as of 29 May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 17th edition of the India-Mongolia joint military exercise **NOMADIC ELEPHANT** is being conducted in **Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia** as of May 2025.
 
• This exercise focuses on enhancing interoperability, mutual understanding, and cooperation between the armed forces of India and Mongolia.
 
• The drill involves joint counter-terrorism operations and peacekeeping missions under the **United Nations mandate**.
 
• Participants from both countries engage in field training exercises, live demonstrations, and discussions to improve military coordination.
 
• The exercise is a part of India's **Act East Policy**, which aims to strengthen ties with countries in the Asia-Pacific region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Mongolia Relations:**

 
 
• India and Mongolia share strong historical, spiritual, and cultural ties based on Buddhism.
 
• The bilateral relationship includes cooperation in defense, education, trade, and environmental conservation.
 
• Mongolia refers to India as its "third neighbor" after China and Russia.
 
 
 
• **Act East Policy:**
 
 
• India's Act East Policy aims to strengthen economic, strategic, and cultural relations with the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• It involves expanding cooperation in trade, connectivity, and defense with ASEAN and East Asian countries.
 
• Military exercises like NOMADIC ELEPHANT align with this policy to deepen regional partnerships.
 
 
 
• **United Nations Peacekeeping:**
 
 
• India is one of the largest contributors to UN peacekeeping missions globally.
 
• These missions involve military personnel from various nations working together to maintain peace in conflict zones.
 
• Exercises like NOMADIC ELEPHANT help prepare forces for such collaborative missions.
 
 
 
• **Mongolian Armed Forces:**
 
 
• Mongolia's military primarily focuses on peacekeeping missions and disaster response.
 
• The country actively collaborates with international partners for defense training and capacity building.
